getgenv().ProjectileAuraConfig = getgenv().ProjectileAuraConfig or {}

if getgenv().ProjectileAuraLoaded then return end
getgenv().ProjectileAuraLoaded = true

local Workspace, RunService = game:GetService("Workspace"), game:GetService("RunService")
local EnemyFolder = Workspace:WaitForChild("NPCFolders"):WaitForChild("EnemyFolder")
local ProjectileFolder = Workspace:WaitForChild("Projectile")

local trackedProjectiles, deletionProjectiles, projectileModes = {}, {}, {}
local block, timerRemaining, isActive = nil, 0, false

local function GetValidEnemies()
    local list = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(EnemyFolder:GetChildren()) do
        local h, r = e:FindFirstChild("Humanoid"), e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if h and h.Health > 0 and r and not (Config.Theseshouldntbetargettedimo.Enabled and Config.Theseshouldntbetargettedimo[e.Name]) then table.insert(list, e) end
    end
    return list
end

local function GetStrongestEnemy()
    local list = GetValidEnemies()
    if #list == 0 then return nil end

    local strongestEnemy = nil
    local maxHealth = -1

    for _, enemy in ipairs(list) do
        local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            local totalHealth = humanoid.MaxHealth + humanoid.Health
            if totalHealth > maxHealth then
                maxHealth = totalHealth
                strongestEnemy = enemy
            end
        end
    end

    return strongestEnemy or list[1]
end

local function GetMainTarget()
    if Config.IHATEYOUSOMUCH.Enabled then
        for _, e in ipairs(EnemyFolder:GetChildren()) do
            if Config.IHATEYOUSOMUCH[e.Name] and e:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and e.Humanoid.Health > 0 then return e end
        end
    end
    return GetStrongestEnemy()
end

local function IsTracked(p)
    return p.Name == "Cesuspot" or p.Name == "Superball" or p.Name == "Pellet" or p.Name == "Soccerball" or p.Name == "Volleyball" or p.Name == "Basketball" or p.Name == "Brew" or p.Name == "Cola" or p.Name == "Goala" or p.Name == "Molotov" or p.Name == "Grenade" or p.Name == "LabTable" or p.Name == "Rocket" or p.Name == "BigRocket" or p.Name == "Iceball" or p.Name == "BigIceball" or p.Name == "WoodArrow" or p.Name == "Paintball" or p.Name == "BigFireball" or p.Name == "Bigfireball" or p.Name == "Fireball" or p.Name == "Duck" or p.Name == "EvilDuck" or p.Name == "CrimsonBall" or p.Name == "SorcusBlade" or p.Name == "MagicBall" or p.Name == "SorcusEgg" or p.Name == "SuperSorcusBlade" or p.Name == "BigStunpellet" or p.Name == "Stunpellet" or p.Name == "CesusBomb" 
    or p.Name == "Bacon" or p.Name == "TumorePellet" or p.Name == "Puck" or p.Name == "NoirBiograft" or p.Name == "Noir" or p.Name == "Goobab" or p.Name == "ElectricFist" or Config.RandomizedProjectiles.List[p.Name]
end

local function checkDeletion(p)
    local d = { "GrandPiano", "LabTable", "ExplodeCannonBall", "SuperExplodeCannonBall", "Arrow", "PirateJuice", "Hyperlaser", "BiggerRocket", "Biggerrocket", "LightBomb", "EpicKunai", "EpicKatana", "RottenEgg", "Hellball", "BigHellball", "Piano", "Execnade", "BigHellBall", "HellRocket", "Hellrocket", "MisterSkull", "ZetaRocket", "Hand", "Hellhand", "HellHand", "HyperBomb", "SuperStar", "TNT", "ZombieBomb", "ElectricRock", "FreedomRocket", "Landmine", "Paintnade", "ThrowingAxe", "BigGhostwalker", "Ghostwalker", "GlowBoxingGlove", "Flashbang",
    "TrollPie", "TinyBomb", "SmallStar", "Rock" }
    for _, name in ipairs(d) do if p.Name == name then p.Anchored = true; deletionProjectiles[p] = true; return end end
end

local function Setup(p)
    p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.Massless, p.Transparency = false, true, true, 1
    p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

ProjectileFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
    if not c:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    checkDeletion(c)
    if c.Name == "StoneFist" or c.Name == "Teapot" or c.Name == "FireTeapot" then
        if not block then block = Instance.new("Part", Workspace); block.Anchored, block.Transparency, block.Size, block.CFrame = true, 1, Vector3.new(6,6,6), CFrame.new(0, -0.25, 1.23) end
        timerRemaining, isActive = 0.8, true
    elseif IsTracked(c) then Setup(c); trackedProjectiles[c] = true end
end)

for _, v in ipairs(ProjectileFolder:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("BasePart") then checkDeletion(v); if IsTracked(v) then Setup(v); trackedProjectiles[v] = true end end end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    for p in pairs(deletionProjectiles) do
        if p and p.Parent then p.CFrame += Vector3.new(0, -100, 0) else deletionProjectiles[p] = nil end
    end
    if isActive then timerRemaining -= dt; isActive = timerRemaining > 0 end
    
    for obj in pairs(trackedProjectiles) do
        if not obj or not obj.Parent then trackedProjectiles[obj] = nil; projectileModes[obj] = nil
        else
            local target = GetMainTarget()
            if target and target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then obj.CFrame = target.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame end
        end
    end
end)
